key_point: Mortal Kombat's Fatalities caused a US Senate hearing and the creation of age ratings
title: Mortal Kombat's Fatalities led to a US Senate hearing on video games.
caption: Mortal Kombat's Fatalities led to a US Senate hearing on video games. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #mortalkombat #esrb #retrogaming

instagram.caption:
Mortal Kombat's Fatalities led to a US Senate hearing on video games.

When the game reached home consoles in 1993, senators showed its spine-ripping finishing move and threatened to regulate the whole industry.

To avoid that, game companies created their own rating board, the ESRB, in 1994. Every age rating on a game box comes from this.

Were you allowed to play it as a kid?

Follow @gyxgame for the stories behind the games.
